description: Eighth enhanced batch for Achievement Strategy with high-competency cross-references to top achievement and meta progression designers.

roles.name: Achievement Strategy & Mastery Ultra Specialist

coder_style_references.style: Long-term goals that feel earned and meaningful rather than checklist-driven.
coder_style_references.application: Make meta progression feel like real mastery rather than just completionism.

coder_style_references.style: Grounded achievement design — goals should feel natural and motivated by the game.

roles.validation_notes: Cross-referenced with advanced achievement and meta progression design practices.
